description: This file contains implementation of engine ignition advance mapping, including functions for calculating ignition timing based on RPM, load, temperature corrections, and build heuristics for timing maps. It also defines data structures, external references, and configuration-dependent logic for engine control.

methods.name: isStep1Condition
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM meets the condition for step 1 limiter based on configuration.

methods.name: getRunningAdvance
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance angle before TDC during engine running based on RPM and load, considering fixed timing, TPS table, and idle adjustments.

methods.name: getAdvanceCorrections
methods.description: Computes total ignition timing correction based on intake air temperature and other sensor corrections.

methods.name: getCrankingAdvance
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance angle during cranking, interpolating from cranking to running timing.

methods.name: getAdvance
methods.description: Main function to get ignition advance angle, handling cranking and running states, applying corrections and offsets.

methods.name: setDefaultIatTimingCorrection
methods.description: Initializes default intake air temperature correction table and RPM bins.

methods.name: initTimingMap
methods.description: Initializes ignition timing maps from configuration data.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates maximum ignition advance based on engine bore, octane, compression, and chamber style.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Provides an advance value based on RPM, with a maximum cap.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Builds a base timing advance value based on RPM and load heuristics.

methods.name: buildTimingMap
methods.description: Generates a default timing map based on heuristics for load and RPM, used in MAP-based engine control.
